sentence.en: Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.
sentence.el: Ιστοσελίδες, λογισμικό και αυτοματισμοί, σχεδιασμένα να διαρκούν.

set.name: Signal
set.mechanism: An E assembled from four separate bars, with the middle bar lit in cyan: precise modules plus one live signal. The same bar-and-gap rule sets the grid, the type and the glow.
set.expression_move: The cyan signal bar is the only bright thing, glowing on midnight.
set.differs_by: The references (Linear, Stripe) own indigo and violet; Vercel owns black and white. Signal holds midnight navy with cyan, a hue only about 2-12% of software marks use, and keeps violet to a faint glow.

logo.concept: A segmented E: three arms and a stem that never touch, the middle arm lit. Software is built from parts that fit precisely; ElIT supplies the signal that makes them run.

misuse.label: Do not close the gaps between the bars
Do not light a different bar

defaults_used.why: The user asked for midnight navy. It is a dark ground here, not a finance-style primary, and cyan does the identifying.
The user asked for a subtle violet. It is kept as a glow and chart colour only, never a primary or text colour, so it stays apart from Linear's and Stripe's indigo.

rationale.claim: Moderustic has no tabular figures, so Geologica carries running text and numbers, and JetBrains Mono carries code, which is native territory for a software company.
Every letter of ElIT (E, l, I, T) is made of straight bars, so a bar module is native to the name rather than imposed on it.
Moderustic's lowercase l has a tail, so ElIT can't be misread as EIIT. Most geometric sans faces draw l and I identically.
Cyan is used in about 2-12% of marks in the logo library's developer, cloud and productivity categories; blue in 19-28%.

findings.message: light: primary #3ddcf4 on background #ffffff is 1.65:1, below 3.0:1 (primary fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: border #e4e6ec on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link #3ddcf4 on text #f1f3f7 is 1.48:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #4d556a on background #0b1531 is 2.42:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
no brand/action colour is very light (L* >= 85) and none is very dark (L* <= 30); the neutrals carry the extremes, which is fine for most identities
